metadata.title: Suspended, Coastal
metadata.transfer: Reread the ping that established nothing before you revise docs/requirements.md.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: SUSPENDED.EXE — Setup Wizard (1 of 3)

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: Algorithmic Data Solutions Ltd. — ADS — holds the contract to modernise The Raft's docking ledger: which boat holds which berth, for how long, paid to whom.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: You are the analyst. You are suspended in a tank of instruments on the control deck. You cannot go below.

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: Two field units go for you. You see and hear only what they report back.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: SUSPENDED.EXE — Setup Wizard (2 of 3)

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: Choose your first field unit. Each perceives one channel only — route a ping through them and you get their channel's report, nobody else's.

choices.text: Nomad — the physical channel — the docks, the boats, what is bolted where
Fixer — the people channel — who books, who pays, who owes
Infiltrator — the records channel — the ledger's files, logs, and access
Influencer — the public channel — what the harbour says out loud, streams, notices

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: SUSPENDED.EXE — Setup Wizard (3 of 3): The Brief

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: Four statements came in before your units ever launched. None of them is a requirement yet.

messages.speaker: stakeholder
messages.text: Make the ledger modern.

messages.speaker: stakeholder
messages.text: Keep it simple. I book from the wheelhouse.

messages.speaker: stakeholder
messages.text: Nobody should lose a berth they paid for.

messages.speaker: stakeholder
messages.text: The council should still be able to see what a captain is doing.

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: You have three pings. Spend them well — not every question earns its cost.

messages.text: [SYSTEM ALERT] Uplink integrity: intermittent. Captains are booking from boats mid-swell; sessions are dropping mid-transaction. A berth can now be half-booked — paid, but not confirmed; confirmed, but not paid.

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: Revise, keep, defer, or reopen. Pick one.

choices.text: Revise — change the position now, no new evidence
Keep — no change, accept the risk
Defer — leave it open for now
Reopen — spend 1 Fate point for one more ping
